cases.scenario: Create a new account for GCRM

playwright.test_title: should create a new account for GCRM

steps.action: Login as Sales user to GCRM
steps.result: User is authenticated and on GCRM home page

steps.action: Navigate to Accounts page from Home page
Click New button on Accounts page
Fill in required fields on New account page and save
steps.result: Account record is created successfully: account detail page displays with success message and account name is visible

cases.scenario: GCRM: Add-On Membership Amendment (Diabetes Management - PPPM)

playwright.test_title: should complete add-on membership amendment for Diabetes Management

steps.action: Login as Admin user to GCRM
steps.result: User is authenticated and on GCRM home page

steps.action: Amend contract for Recurring Services by choosing Change order on Manage Install Base dialog
steps.result: Edit Quote page is displayed with amendment quote

steps.action: Exit from Edit Quote page and navigate to quote page
Navigate to Amendment Opportunity from quote page and update fields
steps.result: Opportunity page displays with Subtype as Change Order, Number of Lives as 500, and Sub-Type Detail as Add-On Membership

steps.action: Navigate to Quote page from Opportunity page
Navigate to Edit Quote page and add Diabetes Management product
steps.result: New Diabetes Management line is added to quote

steps.action: Edit the new Diabetes Management line and update Per Unit Discount to -3
steps.result: Diabetes Management line displays with Net ARR USD 7,020.00, Participant Quantity 30, Quantity 7.50, and Subscription Fee USD 78.00

steps.action: Type N/A in Reason for Approval field and save, then submit the quote for Approval
Navigate to Amendment Opportunity from quote page and verify final values
steps.result: Opportunity displays with Sub-Type Detail as Add-On Membership and Bookings Total USD 7,020.00
